title: File:Krakow 2024 030 St Mary Basilica - Tops of Towers.jpg
desc:
Saint Mary's Basilica (Kościół Mariacki), is a Brick Gothic church re-built in the fourteenth century (originally built in the early thirteenth century), adjacent to the Main Market Square (Rynek Głowny) in Kraków, Poland. 
Kraków is the second-largest and one of the oldest cities in Poland. Situate
